description: A PostHog error tracking grouping rule: exceptions that match a property filter are grouped into the same issue, optionally assigned to a user or role.

Type.description: Assignee type. `user` for a user ID or `role` for a role UUID.

Id.description: User ID when Type is `user`, or role UUID when Type is `role`.

ApiKey.description: PostHog personal API key (phx_...) with the scopes this resource type needs. Pass it with a dynamic reference such as {{resolve:ssm-secure:/posthog/api-key}} when calling SetTypeConfiguration; never put it in plain text.

BaseUrl.description: PostHog API host. Leave unset for PostHog Cloud US (https://us.posthog.com); use https://eu.posthog.com for PostHog Cloud EU, or your instance URL when self-hosting.

ProjectId.description: ID of the PostHog project the rule belongs to.

Filters.description: JSON (use Fn::ToJsonString). Property-group filter that defines which exceptions are grouped into the same issue, e.g. {"type": "AND", "values": [{"key": "$exception_types", "type": "event", "operator": "exact", "value": ["ChunkLoadError"]}]}.

Assignee.description: Optional user or role to assign to issues created by this rule. PostHog cannot change it after creation, so changing it replaces the rule.

Description.description: Optional human-readable description of what the rule is for. PostHog cannot change it after creation, so changing it replaces the rule.

OrderKey.description: Evaluation priority among grouping rules; lower is evaluated first.
